findings.detail: AC-3 checks `git show --stat "$SHA" | grep -q 'orch-state.json'` to confirm a po commit carries its own orch-state.json write, and fires a BUG telegram on miss. This misses whenever a peer commit sweeps po's own orch-apply.sh write into HEAD before po's own commit lands — po's diff then legitimately carries only notebook+journal, no orch-state.json path, and the check still fires a false BUG. Occurred this run: peer commit b0c5d42b9 swept the write, po's own b6bf37d10 carried only notebook+journal. Po worked around it inline by verifying via `git show HEAD:docs/data/orch/orch-state.json` (content-in-HEAD) instead of trusting the AC-3 script (path-in-own-diff). Fix should re-scope AC-3 to check content landed in HEAD, not that po's own commit's diff names the path.
findings.severity: low — self-worked-around this run, no data/board consequence, but will misfire again on the next peer-sweep race

findings.detail: Reports 4911 (SPIKE-BCTC, 34,725 B — unratifiable by anyone under the 12,000 B prose ceiling) and 4912 remain status=new and will keep resurfacing every triage pass because po's documented tool package has no claim/process step for the telegram-report queue. Po acted on their content this run anyway but could not drain the queue state.
findings.severity: low — non-blocking, but queue will keep re-surfacing the same reports until the tool package is extended
